answer: Bindings are kept in inlet, verified in harbor, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 3 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the jetty check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history thus fails the binding, so that it has to store and read state per alias. A farm of 1068 identities would post 4909 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
